question: Which friendly bacteria is most commonly found keeping a healthy reproductive-age vagina happy and protected?
explanation: Lactobacillus is our hero bug here! It's the dominant, protective bacterium that keeps the vaginal environment healthy and balanced. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h1)

question: Why is having a naturally acidic vaginal pH so important for a patient's health?

options.A: It prevents normal hormonal cycles from stopping
options.B: It stops harmful bacteria and yeast from growing
options.C: It directly digests heavy menstrual blood
options.D: It helps sperm survive longer during intercourse

explanation: Think of the acidic environment as a natural shield! Lactic acid makes it tough for bad germs to multiply and cause trouble. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h1)

question: Bacterial vaginosis (BV) happens when there is an overgrowth of which specific organism?
explanation: You got it! Gardnerella vaginalis and other anaerobic bacteria multiply too much in BV, pushing out our helpful flora. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h2)

question: Out of the common types of vaginitis, which one is officially classified as a sexually transmitted infection (STI)?
explanation: Trichomoniasis is caused by a tiny parasite and is primarily passed along through sexual contact. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h2)

question: Why does taking strong, broad-spectrum antibiotics often lead to an annoying yeast infection?

options.B: It increases the production of vaginal glycogen
options.D: It directly stimulates fungal spore production

explanation: Antibiotics are great, but they aren't picky—they wipe out our protective friendly bacteria right along with the bad ones, leaving yeast free to party! [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h3)

question: A patient with poorly controlled diabetes asks why she keeps getting recurring yeast infections. What is the best way to explain this?

options.A: Pancreatic failure directly causes severe vaginal itching
options.B: High sugar levels in her body secretions feed the fungus
options.C: Her body cannot absorb oral antifungal medications
options.D: Diabetes permanently destroys her ovaries and estrogen

explanation: Fungus loves sugar! Extra glucose in body tissues and secretions gives Candida the exact food source it needs to grow like crazy. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h3)

question: Which symptom is a classic sign of a vulvovaginal yeast infection (candidiasis)?

options.A: Yellow-green, frothy discharge with strawberry spots
options.B: Thick, white, cottage-cheese-like discharge with intense itching
options.C: Thin, gray-white discharge with a strong fishy odor
options.D: Clear, watery discharge with severe lower abdominal pain

explanation: Spot on! Yeast infections are famous for that thick, white discharge and relentless itching, without a fishy smell. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h4)

question: What kind of vaginal odor is classically tied to bacterial vaginosis?
explanation: You got it. The chemical byproducts created by those extra anaerobic bacteria give off a distinct fishy smell. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h4)

question: During an exam, why do clinicians sometimes add potassium hydroxide (KOH) to a vaginal discharge sample?

options.A: To release a fishy odor in bacterial vaginosis
options.B: To lower the sample pH to an acidic level
options.C: To freeze the sample for laboratory transport
options.D: To stain the lactobacilli bacteria bright blue

explanation: It's called the 'whiff test'! Potassium hydroxide helps release those hidden smelly amines, making a fishy odor much easier to spot if BV is present. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h5)

question: Why is getting an accurate diagnosis so important before treating any vaginal infection?

options.A: All vaginal infections automatically resolve on their own within forty-eight hours
options.B: Over-the-counter creams permanently damage normal vaginal tissue if used incorrectly
options.C: Treatments vary completely depending on whether the cause is bacterial, fungal, or parasitic
options.D: Providers cannot prescribe any medication without a blood test confirming the infection

explanation: Makes total sense, right? Antifungals cure yeast, antibiotics treat bacteria, and anti-parasitics handle trich. Using the wrong drug won't help our patient at all! [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h5)

question: Which medication is a go-to choice for treating both bacterial vaginosis and trichomoniasis?
explanation: Metronidazole is a fantastic workhorse antibiotic and anti-parasitic agent that handles both of these conditions wonderfully. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h6)

question: A female patient is diagnosed with trichomoniasis and given oral metronidazole. What crucial instruction must you give her?

options.A: She can safely drink alcohol while completing this therapy
options.B: Her sexual partner must also be treated at the same time
options.C: She should stop taking the drug as soon as itching stops
options.D: She must apply the medication directly as a vaginal cream

explanation: Since trich is an STI, treating partners together stops the annoying 'ping-pong' reinfection cycle where they just pass it right back. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h6)

question: Which hygiene habit should nurses advise patients to ditch because it washes away protective vaginal flora?
explanation: Douching disrupts that natural acidic balance and flushes out our helpful lactobacilli friends, opening the door wide for infections. [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h7)

question: Why do healthcare providers recommend breathable cotton underwear and loose clothing to prevent infections?

options.A: They increase local blood circulation to speed up tissue repair
options.B: They stop normal hormonal fluctuations from occurring
options.C: They prevent allergic reactions to harsh laundry detergents
options.D: They reduce moisture and heat buildup that encourages fungal growth

explanation: Yeast and bad bacteria love warm, dark, sweaty spaces. Breathable fabrics keep things cool, dry, and healthy! [learn more](GNS216_U5_T10#GNS216_U5_T10_h7)
